verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Mem0 serves an llms.txt at docs.mem0.ai/llms.txt (HTTP 200) with an agent-oriented summary. The docs are published as .md pages and include agent-targeted guides, such as agent self-signup from the terminal and a CLI 'for both humans and AI agents'. missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of agents actually consuming the llms.txt/docs, and evidence of a fuller llms-full.txt-style corpus.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
